newsitem.title: GERMANY: Volksfuersorge life unit to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Volksfuersorge life unit to raise capital.

text.p: German insurer Volksfuersorge Holding AG said on Thursday that its life subsidiary Volksfuersorge Deutsche Lebenversicherung planned to raise nominal capital by 20 million marks ($11.9 million) to 220 million marks.
In a compulsory statement the group also said its life unit planned to raise its dividend to 12.50 marks per share for 1996 from 12 marks a year ago.
Volksfuersorge decided at its annual shareholders meeting to raise capital in the group by 20 million to 220 million marks using a cash injection of 200 million marks.
The capital raise will involve the issue of 400,000 new nominal shares at 50 marks each.
The new shares will be issued to shareholders at a price of 75 marks per share. Shareholders will be entitled to retroactive earnings from January 1, 1997.
